hero.subtitle: Compare Austrian insurance products by coverage, exclusions, deductibles and price — with explainable AI-assisted analysis of insurance documents.

ai.title: AI-assisted analysis
ai.body: A transparent OCR and NLP pipeline extracts coverage, exclusions, deductibles and limits directly from insurance documents.

comparison.title: Comprehensive comparison
comparison.body: Compare price, coverage, exclusions, deductibles and risk level side-by-side for up to three policies.

austria.title: Austrian insurers
austria.body: Catalogue coverage from UNIQA, Allianz Austria, Wiener Städtische, Generali Austria and Donau Versicherung.

upload.title: Upload or select
upload.body: Upload your own policy document, or select a policy from the demonstration catalogue.

analysis.title: AI-assisted analysis
analysis.body: Our OCR and NLP pipeline extracts coverage, exclusions, deductibles and limits from the document text.

compare.title: Compare beyond price
compare.body: Compare up to three policies side-by-side on price, coverage, exclusions and deductible — not premium alone.

understand.title: Understand the recommendation
understand.body: See exactly how each factor — coverage, price, exclusions, deductible, and profile fit — contributed to the score.

whyInsureCompare.title: Beyond price comparison
whyInsureCompare.subtitle: A lower premium does not automatically mean a better fit. InsureCompare.at evaluates coverage, exclusions, deductibles, document evidence and your own preferences alongside price.
whyInsureCompare.footnote: "Conventional comparison approach" refers to price-led aggregator platforms generally, not a specific named product.

about.body: InsureCompare.at helps you compare Austrian insurance policies on more than price — coverage, exclusions, deductibles and document evidence — and understand your own insurance documents with the AI Policy Advisor.
